We invite applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in Information Retrieval and Temporal Question Answering at the Department of Computer Science, University of Innsbruck, Austria.

The position is full-time, for 4 years, starting on 15 September 2026.

The successful candidate will conduct independent research in Information Retrieval, user search behaviour studies, contribute to teaching and student supervision, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s theses. The position also includes participation in evaluation activities and coordination-related tasks.

Applicants should have:

•

a completed doctoral degree / PhD;

•

excellent knowledge of Information Retrieval and Temporal QA;

•

very good programming skills, preferably in Python or Java;

•

a strong publication record (several core A* publications);

•

teaching experience and excellent communication skills in English.

Application deadline: 28 May 2026
